description: Helps you decide which customers to go after next. You give your best customers, as a list (industry, size, contract value, sales cycle, tech stack, buying trigger, champion title) or in your own words. You get the patterns they share, with ties named as ties, the budget shown as the contract value range seen in your customers, recommendations, and sector notes when your inputs name a supported sector. It works only from what you give and looks nothing up. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Without customers or customer_descriptions, it returns a request for customer data with example input formats. Invalid typed values return a correction error. Use this instead of icp_gap_analysis when you need patterns in supplied customers before comparing them with an ideal profile.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

customer_descriptions.description: Alternative: Describe your best customers in text format. Format is text. For example, "manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees".

customers.description: List of customer objects with available attributes. Format is a JSON array. For example, [{"name":"an approved anonymous manufacturer","industry":"manufacturing","size":"200 to 500 employees"}].

items.description: Format is a JSON object. For example, {"name":"an approved anonymous manufacturer","industry":"manufacturing","size":"200 to 500 employees"}.

acv.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 24000.

buying_trigger.description: Format is text. For example, "an audit review due next quarter".

champion_title.description: Format is text. For example, "finance director".

name.description: Format is text. For example, "an approved anonymous manufacturer".

sales_cycle_days.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

size.description: Format is text. For example, "200 to 500 employees".

tech_stack.description: Format is a JSON array. For example, ["existing accounting system"].

items.description: Format is text. For example, "existing accounting system".

product_category.description: What type of product you sell. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: icp_deep_dive
